title: Nx daemon admission
description: Bounded Nx daemons for many concurrent sessions in one checkout. Finite (non-watch) daemons are capped by a memory share of the host and by an authored maximum, watch daemons by their own maximum; a namespace that already has a live daemon is always reused; a daemon holds one numbered slot lease for its whole life, so the cap is enforced by the daemons themselves; finite daemons shut down after an idle period (shorter on a lean host of at most 24 GiB) or, once idle, as soon as their resident memory exceeds a budget (lower on a lean host); every daemon publishes its resident memory as a record the host capacity governor can read.
